nb4f1d0f902.headline: Tullow Oil moves forward on Ghana licence extensions and gas agreement
nb4f1d0f902.summary: Tullow Oil is addressing outstanding issues, including securing payment mechanisms for gas sales and an updated plan of development for the Jubilee oilfield. The work concerns its Ghana licence extensions.
nb4f1d0f902.why: Tullow Oil is an independent oil and gas explorer and producer whose main assets are in West Africa, including the Jubilee field offshore Ghana. Licence terms and gas sales arrangements directly affect its revenue.

n0542cc72dd.headline: New figures show one in five first-time buyers over 40
n0542cc72dd.summary: New Santander data shows the oldest first-time buyer it supported in 2025 was 70 years old. The figures point to one in five first-time buyers being over 40.
n0542cc72dd.why: Santander UK is a major mortgage lender, so its first-time buyer data gives a read on housing affordability and demand in Britain.

n418543b1eb.headline: Give thanks for the discounts: The feast will cost a little less this year
n418543b1eb.summary: Shoppers can expect discounts on turkey and stuffing this year. Overall grocery prices are up, but this year's Thanksgiving meal should cost a bit less than last year's.
n418543b1eb.why: Food price trends feed into US consumer inflation, which influences Federal Reserve policy and consumer spending.

n23ce94a6e9.headline: Upgrade in Fitch forecast reflects resilience of Georgia
n23ce94a6e9.summary: Fitch Ratings upgraded Georgia's sovereign credit outlook to stable, citing the country's resilience to external shocks, according to the Ministry of Economy. The report was relayed from Baku.
n23ce94a6e9.why: Sovereign credit outlooks from rating agencies influence borrowing costs and the attractiveness of a country's bonds to foreign investors.

n2c46ebf642.headline: Darlington BS enters limited company BTL market
n2c46ebf642.summary: Darlington Building Society has launched limited company buy-to-let lending with two product options.
n2c46ebf642.why: Building societies are UK mutual lenders, and expanding into buy-to-let for limited companies adds to competition in the UK mortgage market.

nbc2ae1f8b8.headline: Gold likely to stay range-bound amid US GDP, inflation data focus: Analysts
nbc2ae1f8b8.summary: Gold prices are expected to stay range-bound near term as investors await key US GDP and inflation releases and Federal Reserve signals on rates.
nbc2ae1f8b8.why: Gold is a traditional store of value whose price often reacts to expectations for US interest rates, inflation and the dollar.

n615e3025c2.headline: Chams Holding Company boosts share capital to 6.65 billion after major private placement
n615e3025c2.summary: Chams Holding Company has listed 1,955,910,000 additional ordinary shares on the NGX after a major private placement, lifting market capitalisation to N21 billion.
n615e3025c2.why: Share issuance through private placements increases a listed company's share capital and can dilute existing shareholders.

n4c8944761c.headline: Brazil central bank still uneasy on inflation outlook, governor says
n4c8944761c.summary: Brazil's central bank governor said policymakers remain dissatisfied with progress toward bringing inflation back to target and will stay data-dependent.
n4c8944761c.why: The central bank sets Brazil's benchmark Selic rate, which influences local yields, the real and borrowing costs across the economy.

n15f2e91fea.headline: Euro rises on peace talks progress
n15f2e91fea.summary: The euro rose on progress in peace talks, boosting European market sentiment amid improved geopolitical conditions.
n15f2e91fea.why: The euro is the shared currency of the eurozone, and its moves reflect shifts in geopolitical risk and relative economic outlook against the dollar.
n15f2e91fea.why_moved: Progress in peace talks improved geopolitical conditions, which the report links to a rise in the euro and firmer European market sentiment.

nfc6704183d.headline: Zoom lifts annual outlook on growing demand for AI tools in hybrid work
nfc6704183d.summary: Zoom Communications raised its annual revenue and profit forecasts, benefiting from hybrid work trends and AI integration in its products.
nfc6704183d.why: Zoom is a video communications software company whose forecasts signal demand for its hybrid-work and AI-enabled products.
nfc6704183d.why_moved: Zoom raised its annual revenue and profit outlook, citing hybrid-work demand and AI integration into its products.

nded692f4d6.headline: World Bank lifts Kenya’s growth forecast on construction sector optimism
nded692f4d6.summary: The World Bank raised Kenya's economic growth forecast for the year to almost 5%. It cited a pick-up in the construction sector in East Africa's largest economy.
nded692f4d6.why: The World Bank's forecasts inform investor views of sovereign risk and growth in emerging markets, and Kenya is a major economy in East Africa.

ne15cd035ff.headline: Oil Closes the Day Up as Equities Rally
ne15cd035ff.summary: Oil closed the day higher as equities rallied. Markets expect choppy pre-holiday trading as peace discussions advance but remain uncertain.
ne15cd035ff.why: Crude oil prices are shaped by supply, demand and geopolitical risk, and they feed directly into inflation, energy costs and corporate margins.
ne15cd035ff.why_moved: Oil rose alongside an equity rally as peace discussions advanced, though the outcome remains uncertain. Lower geopolitical risk can ease supply concerns and boost risk appetite.

n37ad3ec637.headline: Sweden's Einride taps Anubhav Verma as CFO ahead of US debut
n37ad3ec637.summary: Swedish self-driving truck company Einride named Anubhav Verma as chief financial officer. The appointment comes ahead of its expected public listing in the US early next year.
n37ad3ec637.why: Einride is an autonomous freight company; a CFO appointment ahead of a US listing is a key step in preparing financial reporting for public investors.

n69f00e02d4.headline: How Shifting Rainfall Patterns Are Quietly Shaping Uganda’s Food Price Dynamics | Science-Environment
n69f00e02d4.summary: Climate volatility has a modest but detectable influence on Uganda's food prices, with rainfall shortages causing small, crop-specific price increases. These effects are expected to strengthen as climate change intensifies.
n69f00e02d4.why: Food prices drive inflation and household budgets in African economies, and weather shocks are a key source of agricultural price volatility.

n38419687fd.headline: Uganda: Devki Group Bets $500m On Uganda Steel Production
n38419687fd.summary: Presidents Yoweri Museveni and William Ruto broke ground on a $500m steel manufacturing complex in Tororo, eastern Uganda. The project aims to reduce dependence on imported metals.
n38419687fd.why: Steel is a core industrial input, and large manufacturing investments in East Africa can affect regional supply chains and mineral value capture.

n48559721df.headline: What is Cartel de los Soles, which the US is labelling a terrorist organisation?
n48559721df.summary: The US says Cartel de los Soles is headed by Venezuela's president and other senior politicians. Some analysts say the group does not even exist.
n48559721df.why: US terrorist designations can trigger sanctions and financial restrictions, affecting banks and firms with exposure to Venezuela.

n333cca28ca.headline: Dollar Slightly Higher on Yen Weakness
n333cca28ca.summary: The dollar index rose about 0.06% as weakness in the yen supported gains in the greenback, with the yen attempting to hold above its level from last Friday.
n333cca28ca.why: The dollar index tracks the US dollar against major currencies and is a key gauge of global currency conditions.

n993974ce7b.headline: Finance brokers expect Budget to worsen conditions for SMEs
n993974ce7b.summary: Finance brokers expect the UK Budget to worsen conditions for small and medium-sized enterprises. Of those surveyed, 76% cite a negative impact on small businesses.
n993974ce7b.why: Small and medium-sized enterprises are a major source of UK employment and depend heavily on bank and broker-arranged credit. Budget measures affecting their costs and financing shape lending demand and economic growth.

n438845efaf.headline: G20 leaders commit to engage on global minimum tax, address challenges from digitalisation of economy
n438845efaf.summary: G20 leaders committed to constructive engagement on global minimum tax concerns and tax challenges from digitalisation, while preserving tax sovereignty, in a declaration after the Johannesburg summit.
n438845efaf.why: The global minimum tax sets a floor on corporate tax rates for multinationals, so changes affect group tax bills and investment location decisions.

n424f088891.headline: Kimchi Premium Could Drop to 0 as South Korea Prepares Major Crackdown Against Top Crypto Exchanges
n424f088891.summary: The kimchi premium on South Korean exchanges has dropped to its lowest level in years, amid declining bitcoin prices and rising bearish sentiment, as South Korea prepares a crackdown on top crypto exchanges.
n424f088891.why: The kimchi premium is the price gap between bitcoin on Korean exchanges and global markets, reflecting local demand and capital-control frictions.
n424f088891.why_moved: Bitcoin prices are declining and bearish sentiment is rising, and the Korean premium has fallen to its lowest level in years as a crackdown on top exchanges is prepared.

nbee3a1abe3.headline: Israel is launching its campaign for a massive increase in U.S. aid - will it succeed?
nbee3a1abe3.summary: Israel wants to start negotiations over a massive new aid deal that could shape U.S.-Israeli relations for 20 years. The article says the outcome is far from certain.
nbee3a1abe3.why: U.S. military aid to Israel is a large recurring government commitment, and its terms affect defense industry contracts and regional security spending.

n9dfcf26967.headline: Dollar steadies as markets await key inflation data and Fed signals
n9dfcf26967.summary: The dollar steadied while markets awaited key inflation data and Federal Reserve signals that could influence monetary policy in December.
n9dfcf26967.why: The US dollar is the world's main reserve currency, and its moves affect global asset prices, commodities and emerging-market debt.

nb2dd73a06c.headline: 'Extraordinary rise': Australia's housing affordability hits worst levels yet
nb2dd73a06c.summary: Housing affordability in Australia has hit its worst levels yet, with an average earner in Sydney's eastern suburbs needing 35 years to save a 20 per cent deposit on a median-priced house.
nb2dd73a06c.why: Housing affordability shapes household spending, mortgage demand and the outlook for Australian banks and property markets.

nc65c81a340.headline: Rumours circulate across Whitehall Labour will increase fuel duty
nc65c81a340.summary: Rumours circulating in Whitehall suggest Labour plans to increase fuel duty by 5p per litre. The report is unconfirmed and its implications are being explored.
nc65c81a340.why: Fuel duty is a tax on petrol and diesel, so changes feed into pump prices, transport costs and consumer inflation.

n8c6434da36.headline: US stocks are set for a green opening with December rate cut surfacing again
n8c6434da36.summary: S&P 500 futures rose ahead of the US open as talk of a December rate cut resurfaced. Investors are reacting to renewed optimism over monetary easing.
n8c6434da36.why: The S&P 500 tracks 500 large US listed companies and is the main gauge of US equity performance. Expectations for Federal Reserve rate cuts influence borrowing costs and equity valuations.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: Futures rising ahead of the open points to a higher expected opening level for the index.

nddf26f18ce.headline: Chimeric Therapeutics receives $4.5 million R&D tax incentive refund
nddf26f18ce.summary: Chimeric Therapeutics received an R&D tax incentive refund of $4,497,886 under the Australian scheme. The company is listed on the ASX and OTC markets.
nddf26f18ce.why: The Australian R&D tax incentive refunds eligible research spending, which can materially extend a biotech's cash runway.

n8bdede9c9a.headline: Chancellor urged to take ‘hard choices’ rather than hit businesses with more tax
n8bdede9c9a.summary: The CBI urged Chancellor Rachel Reeves to make hard choices rather than raise taxes on businesses. Its director general called for her to stand up to opposition to welfare cuts.
n8bdede9c9a.why: The CBI is the UK's main business lobby group, and tax and spending decisions in the budget affect corporate costs and public finances.

n86727d0856.headline: India And Canada Resume FTA Talks, Aim For USD 50 Billion Trade By 2030
n86727d0856.summary: India and Canada have resumed free trade agreement talks, aiming for $50 billion in bilateral trade by 2030. Negotiations had been paused in 2023 after a diplomatic rift.
n86727d0856.why: A free trade agreement between India and Canada would reduce tariffs and ease investment and trade flows between two large economies.

nd690947c08.headline: How to cut your petrol costs as budget fuel duty increase could put 5p on a litre
nd690947c08.summary: Fuel duty could rise by 5p per litre in the budget, alongside a 3p pay-per-mile charge for electric vehicles and the return of the fuel price escalator. The measures are under consideration.
nd690947c08.why: Fuel duty is a tax on petrol and diesel in the UK, and changes to it feed directly into consumer prices and fuel demand.

n5ee7efbfa7.headline: Federal government puts Luxury Car Tax on the chopping block – again
n5ee7efbfa7.summary: The federal government is considering abolishing the Luxury Car Tax, which has been teased as part of a policy package. Scrapping it would make European cars cheaper.
n5ee7efbfa7.why: The Luxury Car Tax is an Australian levy on high-value vehicles, and changes to it affect car prices and imports.

n885e665f36.headline: Nasdaq Technical Analysis: Higher rate cut odds lift the risk sentiment
n885e665f36.summary: The Nasdaq rebounded from October lows after dovish comments from Fed official Williams and positive Nvidia news. Rate-cut odds have risen.
n885e665f36.why: The Nasdaq Composite is a major US equity index heavily weighted toward technology companies, so it is sensitive to expectations for Federal Reserve policy.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: The article cites positive Nvidia news as one driver of the rebound.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n885e665f36.why_moved: Dovish comments from Fed official Williams raised expectations of rate cuts, and positive Nvidia news supported risk sentiment after October lows.

n4d4b3601d4.headline: 4 Ways Amazon’s and Other Recent Layoffs Could Affect the Economy — and Your Wallet
n4d4b3601d4.summary: Recent layoffs including Amazon's are being assessed by financial experts for their potential effects on the economy and household finances. The article does not give layoff figures.
n4d4b3601d4.why: Amazon is one of the largest US employers and retailers, so its workforce reductions are watched as a signal for labor market and consumer spending trends.

impacts.name: Amazon
impacts.why: Layoffs at Amazon are the event under discussion, with possible knock-on effects on spending.

n2d430b7d75.headline: ‘It’s terrifying.’ Wyoming leads country with highest jump in Obamacare costs
n2d430b7d75.summary: For a 60-year-old Wyoming resident earning $63,000 a year, average monthly ACA premium costs are rising 421%, the largest increase in the country according to the report.
n2d430b7d75.why: The Affordable Care Act marketplace sets premiums and subsidies for individual health plans, so premium changes affect insurers, healthcare costs and household budgets.

nde764d176f.headline: Experts call for billion-euro AI plan to keep NL competitive
nde764d176f.summary: More than 50 AI experts recommended a large-scale national investment programme with multi-billion-euro annual investment to keep the Netherlands competitive.
nde764d176f.why: AI investment programmes shape public funding and demand for technology, data infrastructure and research spending.

n30b87c78b2.headline: Gold steady as markets await key US data after shift in rate-cut expectations
n30b87c78b2.summary: Gold prices held steady as investors awaited upcoming US data that may influence rate-cut expectations. The article notes a shift in those expectations.
n30b87c78b2.why: Gold is a traditional store of value that tends to be sensitive to interest-rate expectations, since lower rates reduce the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding bullion.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Gold prices are held steady while investors weigh expected US rate-cut signals from upcoming data.

n9ec2ed4d93.headline: Sanctions and corruption case against Damen opens in Zwolle
n9ec2ed4d93.summary: The criminal case against shipbuilder Damen Shipyards opened in Zwolle, with allegations of large-scale bribery and breaching Russia sanctions. Hearings are preliminary and the trial is expected to take years.
n9ec2ed4d93.why: Damen is a Dutch shipbuilder with annual revenues of about €3 billion, so legal and sanctions risks can affect its operations and reputation.

n623dd7232c.headline: Flour restrictions risk humanitarian crisis in K-P
n623dd7232c.summary: With the supply of flour halted from Punjab, residents of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa are deprived of a fundamental commodity, risking a humanitarian crisis.
n623dd7232c.why: Flour is a staple food, so supply disruptions between provinces affect food prices and availability across Pakistan.

n6460d0f5c8.headline: Hike in home heating oil price - Midwest Radio
n6460d0f5c8.summary: Oil distributors in the west of Ireland report a surge in demand, leading to a hike in home heating oil prices.
n6460d0f5c8.why: Home heating oil is a refined product priced off crude and gasoil markets, so retail price moves reflect wholesale fuel costs and seasonal demand.

source.name: Midwest Radio - Midwest Radio Local Radio Station For The West Of Ireland (MWR)

sources.name: Midwest Radio - Midwest Radio Local Radio Station For The West Of Ireland (MWR)

nde38181d27.headline: India diversifies export basket as shipments to US decline: SBI research report
nde38181d27.summary: India's merchandise exports rose 2.9% to $220 billion in April-September 2025. Shipments to the US declined since July, indicating a wider export mix, an SBI research report said.
nde38181d27.why: Export composition and trade partner concentration affect India's current account, growth outlook and exposure to US tariff policy.

nacead1a286.headline: Landlords 'stampede' out of rental market ahead of new changes coming next year
nacead1a286.summary: New rental rules will not affect tenants in place before March 1. Tenancies starting after that date will get a six-year agreement, according to Limerick Live.
nacead1a286.why: Rental regulation shapes landlord returns and the supply of rental housing, which feeds into property markets and related lenders.

n0642f94fd8.headline: Auto sector outlook: Policy tailwinds to spur 2–3 year demand revival; analysts warn of uneven segment growth
n0642f94fd8.summary: India's auto sector expects a strong demand surge over the next two to three years, fuelled by government initiatives including income tax reductions. Analysts warn growth will be uneven across segments.
n0642f94fd8.why: Autos are a large consumer-facing industry, and their demand is a useful gauge of household spending and manufacturing activity.

n034214cf0e.headline: Singapore court clears way for US$2.7 billion suit against StanChart in 1MDB scandal-linked claim
n034214cf0e.summary: A Singapore court cleared the way for a US$2.7 billion suit against Standard Chartered over a 1MDB-linked claim. The claims involve an alleged US$150 million deposit to Najib Razak and US$77 million for Rosmah Mansor's bags and jewellery.
n034214cf0e.why: Standard Chartered is a London-listed bank with major operations in Asia, Africa and the Middle East, and 1MDB-related litigation has been a long-running legal and reputational risk.

n01b75c96d5.headline: As Wall Street Sounds the Alarm on an AI Bubble, Warren Buffett Is Selling Apple Stock. Should You?
n01b75c96d5.summary: Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway is trimming its Apple stake as Wall Street voices growing fears of an AI bubble. The decision has prompted questions about whether investors should follow.
n01b75c96d5.why: Berkshire Hathaway is a large conglomerate led by Warren Buffett, and its stock picks are closely watched. Apple is one of the largest companies in the S&P 500 and a major Berkshire holding.

impacts.name: Apple
impacts.why: Berkshire is reducing its holding in Apple, which may affect demand for the shares from a major investor.

na4a23813a2.headline: Alvotech Announces Approval of AVT03, a Biosimilar to Prolia® and Xgeva® (denosumab) in the European Economic Area
na4a23813a2.summary: Alvotech announced approval of AVT03, a biosimilar to Prolia and Xgeva (denosumab), in the European Economic Area on November 25, 2025. The company is a global biotech based in Reykjavik.
na4a23813a2.why: Biosimilars are lower-cost copies of biologic medicines, and approvals open new revenue streams for their developers. Alvotech is an Icelandic contract developer and manufacturer of biosimilars.

n51b89784ef.headline: LexinFintech Holdings Ltd. Reports Third Quarter 2025 Unaudited Financial Results
n51b89784ef.summary: LexinFintech, a China-based technology-enabled personal financial services provider, has published unaudited results for the third quarter of 2025. The release was issued from Shenzhen.
n51b89784ef.why: LexinFintech is a Chinese consumer credit platform, and its results reflect demand for personal lending in China.

ndec794a37e.headline: Scandic Hotels Board Member Kristina Patek Increases Her Shareholding
ndec794a37e.summary: Scandic Hotels board member Kristina Patek increased her shareholding on November 19 by buying 1,945 shares. The shares were acquired at 84.95 SEK each.
ndec794a37e.why: Scandic Hotels is a Nordic hotel operator, and board-member share purchases are public disclosures that investors monitor.

nd83726fd2f.headline: Singapore’s core, headline inflation both rise to higher-than-expected 1.2% in October
nd83726fd2f.summary: Singapore's core and headline inflation both rose to 1.2% in October, higher than expected, with the MAS and MTI maintaining their outlooks.
nd83726fd2f.why: The Monetary Authority of Singapore manages monetary policy through the exchange rate, so inflation readings shape its currency policy and the Singapore dollar outlook.

n27fabb725c.headline: Holiday week could be prime time for yen intervention
n27fabb725c.summary: Japanese markets were closed for a holiday on Monday, and currency traders are watching for possible yen intervention during the holiday week.
n27fabb725c.why: Yen intervention by Japanese authorities can move the dollar-yen exchange rate sharply, affecting exporters, carry trades and global currency markets.

na46833fecf.headline: License-out hopes lift Pharos iBio, MedPacto [K-Bio Pulse]
na46833fecf.summary: Shares of Pharos iBio, Oncocross and MedPacto rose on November 19 on hopes of licence-out deals, according to Korean financial daily Edaily.
na46833fecf.why: Licensing deals let drug developers earn payments by granting rights to their drug candidates to larger pharmaceutical partners, which can drive biotech valuations.

n753e606be4.headline: Grindr ends talks on $3.46 billion take-private bid over financing uncertainty
n753e606be4.summary: Grindr ended talks on a $3.46 billion take-private bid due to financing uncertainty, while saying it remains confident in its strategy and has kept its full-year revenue growth forecast of about 26%.
n753e606be4.why: Take-private bids are offers to buy a publicly listed company and delist it; Grindr is a US-listed online social network for gay, bi and queer men.

n88b0d05722.headline: SEC OKs ACEN unit’s capital stock hike
n88b0d05722.summary: Enex Energy Corp., a subsidiary of Ayala-led ACEN Corp., has received regulatory approval to increase its authorized capital stock. The move gives it more room to raise fresh funds for growth.
n88b0d05722.why: ACEN is a Philippine renewable energy developer, and a larger authorized capital base allows its subsidiaries to issue new shares to finance projects.

n9f0cb7ff15.headline: CLI gets SEC nod to sell P5 billion bonds
n9f0cb7ff15.summary: Property developer Cebu Landmasters has received regulatory approval to offer up to P5 billion in sustainability bonds. The proceeds will raise fresh capital to help meet debt payments.
n9f0cb7ff15.why: Cebu Landmasters is a Philippine property developer. Bond issuance is a key funding channel for real estate firms, and sustainability bonds are labelled for green or social projects.

nc83b446e8e.headline: India trade deal could serve as a ‘powerful economic anchor’ between the two countries: Canada
nc83b446e8e.summary: Indian and Canadian leaders expressed confidence that the CEPA trade agreement will serve as a powerful economic anchor. They aim to more than double two-way trade to C$70 billion by 2030.
nc83b446e8e.why: A comprehensive economic partnership agreement lowers trade barriers and shapes bilateral flows of goods, services and investment between the two countries.

n8cde5c2a46.headline: Workers watch closely as vote looms to merge B.C.’s Teck with U.K.’s Anglo American
n8cde5c2a46.summary: Workers are watching a looming vote on combining Teck, based in British Columbia, with U.K.-based Anglo American. Teck says the combined firm would be one of the world's top copper producers.
n8cde5c2a46.why: Teck Resources is a major Canadian diversified miner with large copper output, and Anglo American is a global mining group, so their combination would reshape copper supply.

impacts.name: Anglo American
impacts.why: Anglo American is the merger counterparty, so the outcome of the vote directly affects its planned combination.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n0999be1d56.headline: 'He should care': Conservatives slam Carney on Trump comments
n0999be1d56.summary: Conservative MPs criticised Prime Minister Mark Carney after he replied "Who cares?" when asked about his last conversation with Donald Trump. Carney was in Johannesburg when he made the comments on trade talks.
n0999be1d56.why: Canada and the United States are each other's largest trading partners, so the status of bilateral trade talks matters for tariffs and cross-border commerce.

n366b37f138.headline: Premier Eby tells Carney it
n366b37f138.summary: B.C. Premier David Eby said he told Prime Minister Mark Carney how unacceptable it was for Alberta and Saskatchewan to discuss a potential pipeline with the federal government without B.C. input.
n366b37f138.why: Interprovincial pipelines carry Canadian oil and gas to export markets, and their routing requires agreement among governments, which shapes project timing and cost.

n518dd3f66c.headline: Toronto Stocks Advance; Barrick Shares Rise on Deal to Resolve Mali Dispute
n518dd3f66c.summary: Toronto stocks advanced at the start of the week, and Barrick shares rose on a deal to resolve a dispute in Mali. Tech stocks were the session's top gainers.
n518dd3f66c.why: Barrick Gold is one of the world's largest gold miners, and its operations in host countries carry political and licensing risk for investors.
n518dd3f66c.why_moved: The deal to resolve the Mali dispute lifted Barrick shares in Toronto trading, which the report links to a broad push higher.
